originality.rationale: Qualitative oscillation of equal-grid Lagrange interpolation, cubic monotonicity conditions, and adaptive data-bounded interpolation are established prior work and are excluded. The accepted claim is the exact monotone-data central-cell range, equality cases, and strict-positive sign reversal for the unmodified four-point cubic. Direct, alias, exact-constant, and broad-source comparisons did not locate an implication-equivalent statement; an incompletely accessible equidistant-node survey and old coefficient tables remain explicit risks.

value.rationale: Data-boundedness and positivity are explicit goals in the interpolation literature, especially on equally spaced meshes. The ordinary four-node cubic is a basic local high-order interpolant, and the theorem gives its complete worst-case range loss on monotone bounded data, rather than a qualitative overshoot warning. The exact constant, extremizers, and strict-positive counterexample are useful as guardrails and regression targets.
